entries.title: Psalms 16:1
segments: <<Michtam of David.>> Preserve me, O God; for in thee do I take refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 16:2
segments: [O my soul], thou hast said unto Jehovah, Thou art my Lord: I have no good beyond thee.

entries.title: Psalms 16:3
segments: As for the saints that are in the earth, They are the excellent in whom is all my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 16:4
segments: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that give gifts for another [god]: Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take their names upon my lips.

entries.title: Psalms 16:5
segments: Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.

entries.title: Psalms 16:6
segments: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; Yea, I have a goodly heritage.

entries.title: Psalms 16:7
segments: I will bless Jehovah, who hath given me counsel; Yea, my heart instructeth me in the night seasons.

entries.title: Psalms 16:8
segments: I have set Jehovah always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 16:9
segments: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth; My flesh also shall dwell in safety.

entries.title: Psalms 16:10
segments: For thou wilt not leave my soul to Sheol; Neither wilt thou suffer thy holy one to see corruption.

entries.title: Psalms 16:11
segments: Thou wilt show me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; In thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
